Not from the train, but from somewhere within.

The lights dimmed further, then brightened again.
And there it was—written in dust on the glass:

No one else moved.
I stepped onto the platform alone.
The train closed behind me and departed silently.
The station was quiet, but real.
Answering the unseen signal at last.
